d: Indonesia is facing another political crisis after Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka reportedly offered to resign during a meeting with President Prabowo Subianto. The offer comes amid a growing controversy over whether Gibran has legally established the required secondary school qualifications for his 2024 election candidacy. In this video, Firstpost examines the legal challenges, calls for his impeachment and the political tensions surrounding his position.
